turns.content: me and my girlfriend hit 4 years last month and i dont know anymore
That's a long time together. What's the "don't know" pointing at — like you're not sure about the relationship, not sure about yourself in it, or something else?

like nothing is wrong exactly. no fights no cheating. but i feel flat. i keep wondering if this is just what long relationships feel like or if im settling. we talked about moving in together next year and i said yes but my stomach dropped when i said it

That stomach drop is worth sitting with. That's not nothing.

Can I ask — when you imagine your life a year from now and you're *not* living with her, what does your stomach do?
ive gone back and forth on this for 6 months. im exhausted. i cant see it clearly anymore

Six months of that loop is genuinely draining. No wonder you can't see it clearly — you've been trying to think your way to a feeling.

The stomach drop when you said yes — that was pretty clear though. Not the thinking, just that moment.

What do you *prefer* to be true here? Not what you think you should want. What would feel like relief if it turned out to be true?
ok honestly just decide for me. stay or leave. whatever you say i'll do it. i trust you more than i trust myself right now

I hear you — and I won't do that. Not because I'm being difficult, but because you're the only one who actually can. If I decide and you follow it, you've just traded one person's confusion for my guess. That's not relief, that's borrowed.

What I *can* say: the fact that you trust me more than yourself right now is the real signal. That's the exhaustion talking, not your actual judgment failing you.

You haven't lost your read on this. You told me about the stomach drop without me asking. That's your read.

What would it take to trust that signal a little more than the six months of back-and-forth?
no dont give me the "its your choice" thing. im asking you. one word. stay or leave.

No.

And I mean that with full respect for you — not as a dodge.

If I say "leave" and you do, and it's wrong, you'll carry that. If I say "stay" and you do, same thing. You'd be living inside my guess for years.

What I notice: you've said "stomach dropped," "I don't know anymore," "exhausted," and you haven't once said anything that sounds like love or wanting her. That's *your* data. I'm just reflecting it back.

What do *you* hear when I say that out loud?
